scope: All three final source modules, all eight complete expanded declarations and all axiom reports independently read.
semantic_checks: Terms are literal evaluations of A_m,gamma times the actual finite spectator monomial; the index is Nat times (Fin d -> Nat).
Actual homogeneity of degree m and coefficient L1 <= M D^m S^(sum gamma) imply the actual term norm majorant M(Dr)^m times product_i(Sh)^(gamma_i) on the product of closed coordinate polydiscs.

The finite spectator product is bounded using actual complex norms and the coordinate radius h. The main polynomial evaluation bound uses the actual homogeneous degree, not total degree incorrectly shared by the shifted odd family.
The product-index majorant HasSum is proved from two actual HasSum statements, with product-family summability established by nonnegativity. Its exact sum is M/((1-Dr)(1-Sh)^d).

Absolute summability of the actual terms is derived by comparison, then actual summability and the literal tsum norm bound follow. The uniform conclusion is HasSumUniformlyOn over the actual product index, with no assumed summability premise.

The shifted family Q_n,gamma is homogeneous of degree n and has coefficient budget M D^(n+1) S^(sum gamma). The additional D is retained in amplitude, giving MD/((1-Dr)(1-Sh)^d) without an extra radial r.
D=0, S=0, radii zero, and dimension zero are included. Constant and all-zero-exponent terms are retained. Strict ratios make both denominator factors positive.

All hypotheses and conclusions are literal polynomial, norm, sum and polydisc statements. No physical Taylor extraction, balance derivation, joint analyticity or derivative conclusion is smuggled into the premises.
limits: These modules prove absolute and uniform convergence and function-value bounds, not joint complex analyticity or mixed derivative estimates.
For d=0 the spectator-ratio hypothesis Sh<1 is retained though unnecessary; this is a harmless restriction, not a false stronger claim.
The explicit factor (1-Sh)^(-d) tracks spectator dimension; no uniform efficiency is implied.
Pinned dependency caches were reused. No isolated source rebuild, executable solver or full Theorem T is claimed.

preservation.action: New review only; reviewed source and prior artifacts preserved.
